build_minihack_package: build the minihack python package using setuptools with version from version.txt and git sha
install_minihack_with_extras: install minihack with optional extras like dev polybeast rllib or wiki dependencies
run_mh_play_script: run the mh-play console script to interact with a minihack environment
run_mh_envs_script: run the mh-envs console script to list available minihack environments
configure_release_build: set MINIHACK_RELEASE_BUILD env var to build a clean wheel without git sha for PyPI upload
